00078 void PlayBufUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00079 { 
00080  const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00081   
00082  double channelBufferPos;
00083  
00084  for(int channel = 0; channel < getNumChannels(); channel++)
00085  {
00086   int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00087   const int bufferSize = buffer_.size();
00088   channelBufferPos = bufferPos;
00089   float* outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00090   float* rateSamples = inputs[Rate].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00091   float* trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00092   float* offsetSamples = inputs[Offset].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00093   float* loopSamples = inputs[Loop].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00094     
00095   while(numSamplesToProcess ) 
00096   {    
00097    float thisTrig = *trigSamples++;
00098    
00099    if(thisTrig > 0.f && lastTrig <= 0.f)
00100     channelBufferPos = 0.0;
00101    
00102    double offset = *offsetSamples++;
00103    double position = offset + channelBufferPos;
00104    
00105    if(*loopSamples++ >= 0.5f) 
00106    {
00107     if(position >= bufferSize)
00108      position -= bufferSize;
00109     else if(channelBufferPos < 0)
00110      position += bufferSize;
00111     
00112     *outputSamples++ = buffer_.getSample(channel, position);
00113     channelBufferPos += *rateSamples++;
00114    
00115     if(channelBufferPos >= bufferSize)
00116      channelBufferPos -= bufferSize;
00117     else if(channelBufferPos < 0)
00118      channelBufferPos += bufferSize;
00119    }
00120    else
00121    {
00122     *outputSamples++ = buffer_.getSample(channel, position);
00123     channelBufferPos += *rateSamples++;
00124    }
00125    
00126    --numSamplesToProcess;
00127    lastTrig = thisTrig;
00128   }  
00129  }
00130  
00131  bufferPos = channelBufferPos;
00132  
00133  if(bufferPos >= buffer_.size())
00134  {
00135   shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00136   setIsDone();
00137  }
00138 }

00156 PlayBuf::PlayBuf(Buffer const& buffer, 
00157      UGen const& rate, 
00158      UGen const& trigger, 
00159      UGen const& startPos, 
00160      UGen const& loop, 
00161      const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00162 { 
00163  // just mix the input ugens, they should be mono
00164  // mix() will just return the original UGen if it has only one channel anyway
00165  
00166  const int numChannels = buffer.getNumChannels();
00167  
00168  if(numChannels > 0 && buffer.size() > 0)
00169  {
00170   initInternal(numChannels);
00171   
00172   UGen startPosChecked = startPos.mix();
00173   generateFromProxyOwner(new PlayBufUGenInternal(buffer, 
00174                 rate.mix(), 
00175                 trigger.mix(), 
00176                 startPosChecked, 
00177                 loop.mix(), 
00178                 doneAction));
00179 
00180   for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00181   {
00182    internalUGens[i]->initValue(buffer.getSample(i, startPosChecked.getValue(0)));
00183   }
00184  } 
00185 }

00261 void RecordBufUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00262 {
00263  const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00264  
00265  int channelBufferPos;
00266  
00267  for(int channel = 0; channel < getNumChannels(); channel++)
00268  {
00269   int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00270   const int bufferSize = buffer_.size();
00271   channelBufferPos = bufferPos;
00272   float* outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00273   float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00274   float* preLevelSamples = inputs[PreLevel].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00275   float* recLevelSamples = inputs[RecLevel].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00276   float* loopSamples = inputs[Loop].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00277   float* bufferSamples = buffer_.getData(channel);
00278   
00279   while(numSamplesToProcess) 
00280   {          
00281    if(*loopSamples++ >= 0.5f) 
00282    {
00283     if(channelBufferPos >= bufferSize)
00284      channelBufferPos = 0;
00285     
00286     float recLevel = *recLevelSamples++;
00287     float rec = *inputSamples++ * recLevel;
00288     float preLevel = *preLevelSamples++;
00289     float pre = bufferSamples[channelBufferPos] * preLevel;
00290     float out = pre + rec;
00291     *outputSamples++ = out;
00292     bufferSamples[channelBufferPos] = out;
00293     channelBufferPos++;
00294     
00295     if(channelBufferPos >= bufferSize)
00296      channelBufferPos = 0;
00297    }
00298    else
00299    {
00300     float rec = *inputSamples++ * *recLevelSamples++;
00301     float pre = bufferSamples[channelBufferPos] * *preLevelSamples++;
00302     float out = pre + rec;
00303     *outputSamples++ = out;
00304     bufferSamples[channelBufferPos] = out;
00305     channelBufferPos++;
00306    }
00307    
00308    --numSamplesToProcess;
00309   }  
00310  }
00311  
00312  bufferPos = channelBufferPos;
00313  
00314  if(bufferPos >= buffer_.size())
00315  {
00316   shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00317   setIsDone();
00318  } 
00319 }

00352 LoopPointsUGenInternal::LoopPointsUGenInternal(Buffer const& buffer, 
00353               UGen const& rate, 
00354               UGen const& start, 
00355               UGen const& end,
00356               UGen const& loop, 
00357               UGen const& startAtZero,
00358               UGen const& playToEnd) throw()
00359 : UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00360  b(buffer),
00361  currentValue((startAtZero.getValue() >= 0.5f) ? 0.f : start.getValue() * b.size()),
00362  lastLoop(false)
00363 {
00364  inputs[Rate] = rate;
00365  inputs[Start] = start;
00366  inputs[End] = end;
00367  inputs[Loop] = loop;
00368  inputs[StartAtZero] = startAtZero;
00369  inputs[PlayToEnd] = playToEnd;
00370 }
00371 
00372 void LoopPointsUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00373 {
00374  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00375  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00376  float* rateSamples = inputs[Rate].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00377  float* startSamples = inputs[Start].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00378  float* endSamples = inputs[End].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00379  float* loopSamples = inputs[Loop].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00380  float* startAtZeroSamples = inputs[StartAtZero].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00381  float* playToEndSamples = inputs[PlayToEnd].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00382  
00383  while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00384  {
00385   float rate = *rateSamples;
00386   float start = *startSamples * b.size();
00387   float end = *endSamples * b.size();
00388   bool loop = *loopSamples >= 0.5f;
00389   
00390   if(start > end)
00391   {
00392    float temp = start;
00393    start = end;
00394    end = temp;
00395    rate = -rate;
00396   }
00397   
00398   currentValue += rate;
00399   
00400   if(loop)
00401   {            
00402    if((rate > 0.f) && (currentValue >= end))
00403    {
00404     if(lastLoop == false)
00405     {
00406      bool fromZero = *startAtZeroSamples >= 0.5f;
00407      
00408      currentValue = fromZero ? 0.f : start;
00409     }
00410     else
00411     {
00412      currentValue -= (end - start);
00413     }
00414    }
00415    else if((rate < 0.f) && (currentValue < start))
00416    {
00417     if(lastLoop == false)
00418     {
00419      bool fromEnd = *startAtZeroSamples >= 0.5f;
00420 
00421      currentValue = fromEnd ? (b.size()-1) : end;
00422     }
00423     else
00424     {            
00425      currentValue += (end - start);
00426     }
00427    }
00428   }
00429   else if(*playToEndSamples < 0.5f)
00430   {
00431    if((rate > 0.f) && (currentValue >= end))
00432    {
00433     currentValue = (float)b.size();
00434    }
00435    else if((rate < 0.f) && (currentValue < start))
00436    {
00437     currentValue = -1.f;
00438    }   
00439   }
00440   
00441   *outputSamples = currentValue;
00442   
00443   rateSamples++;
00444   startSamples++;
00445   endSamples++;
00446   loopSamples++;
00447   startAtZeroSamples++;
00448   playToEndSamples++;
00449   outputSamples++;
00450   
00451   lastLoop = loop;
00452  }
00453 }
